_purpose: Experiment 1 STEP-MATCHED COMPUTE CONTROL (maintainer, 2026-08-02). Identical to e1_r5500k_sa_pca in every field except the rung: same PCA init, same seed 20260726, same optimizer, same step-based LR schedule (4412 total steps, 221 warmup, min_lr_frac 0.1), same 16 validation blocks, same eval protocol. Only the amount of UNIQUE training data differs — 216 blocks instead of 2941, i.e. ~40.9 effective epochs instead of 3.0. It is a step-matched control, NOT a token-compute-matched control: packing density differs across rungs (1,171 vs 1,870 supervised tokens per block), so matching steps does not match supervised tokens processed.
